issue: Data not persisted across page reload
actual: Added entry "Test Entry Alpha" (and a "Notes" field, and another entry "Number Test Entry") appeared immediately in the UI. After navigating to the same URL (reload), the app reverted to only the original 5 seed entries and the original 4 fields; all newly created entries and the new field were gone.
evidence: Pre-reload: 7 entries incl. "Test Entry Alpha" and "Number Test Entry", 5 fields incl. "Notes". Post-reload snapshot: table shows only 5 original rows and 4 original columns (no Notes column).
Added a new "Notes" text field via Fields dialog; it immediately appeared as a new column in the table header, as a labeled input in the Add Entry form, and as a labeled attribute in Cards view.

Created entry with Task Name="Test Entry Alpha" (text), Priority=5 (number), Due Date=2026-09-01 (date), Completed=Yes (checkbox), Notes="Sample note text" (text). All values appeared correctly and identically in both Table and Cards views immediately after saving.
Switched between Table and Cards views multiple times; all 6 entries and their field values (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical in both views.

Sorted Cards view by Priority (asc then desc, correctly reordered each time). Switched to Table view: sort was NOT applied there (unsorted/manual order shown). Sorted Table by Priority ascending independently. Switched back to Cards: it retained its own earlier "Priority descending" sort, unaffected by Table's sort - confirming independent, auto-saved per-view sort state.

actual: No UI control, button, icon, or menu for defining filter criteria exists anywhere in the app. Only a sort menu and a search box are present.
evidence: Full-page DOM search (case-insensitive) for the string "filter" and for a "lucide-filter" icon class returned zero matches; header toolbar only contains Search box, Sort button, Table/Cards toggle, and Add Entry button.

With no sort active, used drag-handle keyboard interaction (Space to pick up, Arrow to move, Space to drop) to manually reorder entries in Table view (Design moved from position 1 to 3) and separately in Cards view (Design moved from position 1 to 5). After switching views, Table retained order [Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team sync, Test Alpha] while Cards retained a different order [Review, Update, Prepare, Team sync, Design, Test Alpha] - confirming independent manual order per view.

actual: No import button, file input, or import UI exists anywhere in the app despite the Fields dialog note stating "Configure fields before importing data."
evidence: Full-page DOM search for "import" (case-insensitive) found only the single note-text occurrence in the Fields dialog; no input[type=file] elements exist in the document.

Priority field is a native input[type=number]. Attempting to type non-numeric text "abc" into it was rejected outright (Playwright error: "Cannot type text into input[type=number]"). Entering valid number 42 was accepted and saved correctly, displayed as "42" in both views.

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Setting an invalid date value "2026-13-45" resulted in the field value becoming empty (browser-level rejection). Setting a valid date "2026-09-10" was accepted and saved correctly, displayed as "Sep 10, 2026".

Sorting Table/Cards by Priority ascending and descending preserved entry count at 6 throughout, and all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) for every entry remained unchanged - only row/card order changed.

actual: Filtering criteria cannot be defined, applied, or cleared since no filter UI exists in the app.
evidence: Same as FT-6: full-page DOM search found no filter-related controls anywhere.

actual: Empty values are not given a consistent, clear representation. Entries whose Notes field was never set (e.g. pre-existing entries after the field was added later) show a "—" placeholder in both Table and Cards views. However, an entry created via the Add Entry form with the Notes field left blank ("Number Test Entry") shows a completely blank cell/attribute value with no placeholder at all, in both views.
evidence: DOM check: existing rows' Notes <td> contains "—"; "Number Test Entry" row's Notes <td> is empty string. Same blank (no dash) confirmed in Cards view for that entry's Notes attribute.

Field type selector in Configure Fields dialog clearly lists labeled options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox (each with icon). Add Entry form renders type-appropriate controls: text textbox for Text field, native number spinbutton for Number field, native date input for Date field, and a checkbox with Yes/No label for Checkbox field.

In Add Entry form, checkbox toggles between "Completed No" and "Completed Yes" labeled states. In Table view, checked entries render a green "check" icon (text-success class) while unchecked render a muted "x" icon. In Cards view, checked/unchecked entries show explicit "Yes"/"No" text alongside icons.

issue: Search matches only raw internal values, not displayed formatted values
actual: Searching for the displayed date format "Jan 15" returned 0 results even though an entry's Due Date is displayed as "Jan 15, 2026". Searching for the raw ISO value "2026-01-15" did return that entry (1 match). Searching for the displayed checkbox state "Yes" (shown in Cards view for Completed=true entries) returned 0 results.
evidence: Search "Jan 15" -> "0 entries matching". Search "2026-01-15" -> "1 entry matching" (Design new landing page). Search "Yes" -> "0 entries matching" despite multiple entries showing Completed: Yes.

Typing "review" (lowercase) into search box matched "Review marketing materials" (case-insensitive), updated the count label to '1 entry matching "review"', and clearing the search box restored all 6 entries with the count returning to "6 entries".

Selecting "Priority" from the Sort menu immediately reordered visible entries ascending; the Sort button label changed to "Priority" (active) and the footer showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". Re-selecting toggled to "Sorted by Priority (descending)" with entries re-ordered accordingly. App remained fully interactive afterward (menu, view toggle, search all functioned normally).
